name: sklearn-fit-demo
notes: The sklearn library pack end to end (docs/25 SS2): a synthetic market feeds SklearnFit, which imports the estimator named by THIS document, fits it, persists model.joblib + a provenance sidecar under the run dir, and hands the fitted model to the toolkit's owned validate scorer through the predict(record) seam. SklearnFit fits exactly what is wired in - any split/causality cut is an upstream filter node someone can read; this demo deliberately wires the full synthetic stream and scores on the val split only. Run: python -m dskit.pipeline run examples/pipeline/sklearn-fit.json --asof 2026-01-01

dataset.notes: role 'data': deterministic settled events with a mid that under-reacts to the truth

qhat.notes: mode 'train' fits fresh and writes artifacts/qhat/model.joblib (+ .json sidecar). To pin a past fit instead: mode 'load' + artifact <path-to-model.joblib> - it restores (hash-verified, params-matched) and never refits.

validate.notes: the owned scorer consumes the signal via predict(record); no baseline wired, so metrics are absolute
